These fixture poms feed scripts/tests/test_vault_dependency_tree.py. Only `good` may pass.
good                      spring-vault-core 4.1.2, explicit, no Cloud Vault starter
vault-4-0-x               spring-vault-core 4.0.5 explicit
vault-managed-by-cloud    spring-vault-core with no version (Cloud BOM manages 4.0.x)
vault-starter             good plus spring-cloud-starter-vault-config
